en.title: On-Demand Laundry Marketplace & Partner App
en.tagline: Customer, washer-partner and admin surfaces across 718 nodes.
en.description: A two-sided laundry marketplace connecting customers, independent washer partners and operational admins, with subscription plans, payment, order management and an investor-facing surface. I designed the nine-page suite — 718 top-level nodes — comprising a 401-child master product page, a 70-node customer mobile flow, a 55-node washer-partner flow and a 44-node investor landing suite. A UI/UX design credit; I did not build or operate the marketplace.

pt.tagline: Superfícies de cliente, lavador parceiro e admin em 718 nós.
pt.description: Um marketplace de lavanderia de dois lados ligando clientes, lavadores parceiros independentes e administradores da operação, com planos de assinatura, pagamento, gestão de pedidos e uma superfície voltada a investidores.
